Set in an alternate feudal Japan, a stoic masterless samurai and a carefree vagabond cross paths with a spirited young girl searching for a mysterious swordsman who smells like sunflowers. Despite their clashing personalities and deadly pasts, the unlikely trio forms an unbreakable bond as they journey together across a chaotic, war-torn land. Along the way, they must face ruthless assassins, political conspiracies, and their own haunting demons in a thrilling quest that will test the limits of their newfound friendship.
